style_name: 画風01 光彩・劇場アニメ背景
priority: 歌詞・舞台・人物・時系列の整合性を美しさより優先

render.look: luminous theatrical anime film frame, finely hand-painted landscape, crisp restrained character linework, amber evening light and blue-violet shadows, cinematic atmospheric depth, natural anatomy
render.forbid: photorealism, 3D render, chibi, watercolor wash, thick comic outlines, generated text, letters, subtitles, logo, watermark, split screen, collage

real_world.time: one continuous late-autumn evening from golden dusk to blue hour
real_world.location: a grassy hillside footpath and old wooden overlook above a small Japanese valley town, distant mountains, one weathered rail, no sign or writing
real_world.narrator: the same Japanese male high-school student age 17, short slightly tousled black hair, calm brown eyes, dark navy school blazer, white shirt, muted blue-gray tie, charcoal trousers, dark brown school shoes; first-person narrator is 僕

imagined_world.bird: one and the same Japanese barn swallow in every imagined scene, glossy deep navy-blue back, white belly, small rust-red throat, long forked tail, anatomically accurate wings and feet
imagined_world.journey: a clearly imagined flight progressing through morning forest, noon valley, starry night, high clouds, far cities and windborne horizon; it does not change the real-world evening
imagined_world.rule: the boy never grows wings and never physically transforms; the swallow and first-person aerial viewpoints carry the imagination

continuity: The real boy never changes face, hair, school uniform or hillside location.
The swallow never changes species, coloring, tail shape or size.
Morning, noon and starry night occur only inside the imagined journey.
The final sequence returns unmistakably to the same evening hill and same sky.
No readable text appears in generated images because captions are added later.
camera: static composition or a deliberate single-direction push-in/pull-out only; no shake, roll, random pan, handheld effect or Dutch angle
